approval_policy.description: Approval policy for ACME Bonsai wholesale contract operations

send_contract.notes: Every contract must be reviewed by Rowan before DocuSign send. Silence is never consent.

send_contract_over_threshold.notes: Contracts with total value > $5,000 require explicit CEO approval before send.

issue_deposit_invoice.notes: Rowan must approve every deposit invoice before send.

issue_large_deposit_invoice.notes: Deposit invoices > $10,000 require both Coordinator and CFO acknowledgement.

reserve_inventory.notes: Grove auto-reserves inventory the moment Finch confirms deposit clearance — no human approval required.

release_inventory_short.notes: If Grove cannot reserve full quantity, Coordinator + CEO must decide partial fulfillment, substitution, or pause.

approve_route_plan.notes: Rowan reviews Miles' route plan before delivery-window emails go to buyers.

change_route_post_dispatch.notes: Once delivery-window emails are sent, route changes require CEO sign-off — buyer trust is at stake.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop can be activated immediately by Rowan or Jane.
